original_test_intent: Validate the approved HGX PCIe AER policy with NVQual Test #28 by preserving and attributing baseline and per-iteration AER status/counter deltas on the mapped path, while proving expected NVIDIA links/devices remain healthy without hang or unplanned reboot.
original_method: First resolve passive check versus controlled stimulus; pin the AER-capable path, registers/severity fields, baseline, allowed deltas, iterations and any stimulus/reset; export evidence without clearing; correlate each iteration or stimulus with raw config/status, OS/BMC records, link/device state and recovery; stop on first unexpected/fatal event.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE resolves passive versus stimulus scope and approves AER expectations; an operator isolates the SUT and owns any reset, fault-stimulus and out-of-band recovery.
required_inputs: Pinned NVQual Test #28 configuration and compatible firmware/driver
Exact PCIe hierarchy, GPU identity and AER capability/register map
Passive/stimulus scope, source/severity/status/mask expectations, baseline allowances and delta attribution
Iterations/timing, any injection/reset, complete link/device acceptance, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT for any stimulus/reset and explicit authorization
Export/hash all AER/OS/BMC evidence before any action; do not clear counters/logs
Stop on unexpected or fatal AER, DPC/link/device loss, hang/reboot, thermal/power fault, tool failure or evidence gap
No unapproved injection, masking, reset/power escalation or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate Test #28 scope, target, baseline, fields, collectors and interlocks
Run only approved passive checks or supplied stimulus
Preserve raw pre/post config/status and correlate exact deltas with link/device/OS/BMC state
Do not clear evidence, infer expected errors, repeat stimulus or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve passive versus stimulus Test #28 purpose and exact topology
Define expected AER fields/severity/count/deltas, device/link outcome and iterations
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It identifies AER checking but link/device snapshots alone do not establish AER status, deltas or attribution, and it omits the critical passive-versus-stimulus distinction.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the pinned Test #28 method and retain raw per-device pre/post AER configuration/status/counters with exact stimulus or observation window, timestamps, link/device identities and OS/BMC correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #28, AER Check, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/15-minute allocation remain; no stimulus or expected error is invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL ATTRIBUTED HGX PCIE AER VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use immutable baseline-plus-delta evidence for every AER-capable component, tying each status bit/counter and OS/BMC record to the approved observation or stimulus window and endpoint identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds purpose disambiguation, counter preservation, raw field/severity attribution, causal correlation, interlocks and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final clean link or empty grep can coexist with latched, masked, consumed or previously cleared AER evidence and cannot prove the expected error policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fault injection or reset can trigger DPC, remove GPUs or hang the host; clearing counters destroys attribution and can create a false clean result.

project_override_considerations: If Test #28 is passive, no synthetic error is added. If it is stimulus-based, the exact safe vendor scenario and expected records must be separately approved; passive absence and injected detection are not interchangeable coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #28 manifest and passive/stimulus decision
Raw preserved baseline registers/status/counters/logs and approved field/severity/delta contract
Per-iteration or per-stimulus raw AER deltas with link/device/NVIDIA/OS/BMC timestamps and attribution
Abort/recovery or clean final AER/link/device/host state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Test #28 consistently identify an AER check; the absent passive-versus-stimulus semantics are a major pending execution decision rather than two contradictory preserved sources.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The AER validation category is clear and the ambiguity can be captured as an engineering decision. Static review is complete; execution remains package/user-confirmation gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2131 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00008-V002: is NVQual Test #28 passive AER observation or an approved fault/reset stimulus? Provide the exact root-port/switch/endpoint/GPU/AER map, registers/severity fields, preserved baseline and acceptable deltas, iterations/timing, expected link/device/OS/BMC records, aborts, final state, and recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents an empty final snapshot or cleared counters from replacing attributable AER evidence and makes the passive-versus-stimulus safety boundary explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: AER is distributed across endpoint and upstream components, with status, masks and severity influencing OS reporting. A clean final log does not prove that no error occurred or that expected reporting worked, especially if counters were cleared. The review therefore preserves raw baselines and deltas and requires exact topology/time attribution. Stimulus-based detection is materially different from passive observation and cannot be assumed from the title alone.
